rules.description: Windows Keyboard for Mac: complete Windows-style shortcuts (all keyboards)

manipulators.description: Ctrl+Shift+C uses the corresponding terminal application command.
Ctrl+Shift+V uses the corresponding terminal application command.
Ctrl+Shift+N uses the corresponding terminal application command.
Ctrl+Shift+T uses the corresponding terminal application command.
Ctrl+Shift+W uses the corresponding terminal application command.
Ctrl+Shift+3 uses the corresponding macOS screenshot command.
Ctrl+Shift+4 uses the corresponding macOS screenshot command.
Ctrl+Shift+5 uses the corresponding macOS screenshot command.
Ctrl+X marks selected Finder items for moving.
Ctrl+V moves Finder items after Ctrl+X.
Ctrl+V remains normal paste when no Finder cut is pending.
F2 renames the selected Finder item.
Enter opens the selected Finder item.
Delete moves the selected Finder item to Trash.
Backspace navigates back in Finder outside text editing.
Ctrl+Shift+Home selects to the start of the document.
Ctrl+Home moves to the start of the document.
Shift+Home selects to the start of the line.
Home moves to the start of the line.
Ctrl+Shift+End selects to the end of the document.
Ctrl+End moves to the end of the document.
Shift+End selects to the end of the line.
End moves to the end of the line.
Ctrl+Shift+Arrow selects by word or paragraph.
Ctrl+Arrow moves by word or paragraph.
Ctrl+Shift+Arrow selects by word or paragraph.
Ctrl+Arrow moves by word or paragraph.
Ctrl+Shift+Arrow selects by word or paragraph.
Ctrl+Arrow moves by word or paragraph.
Ctrl+Shift+Arrow selects by word or paragraph.
Ctrl+Arrow moves by word or paragraph.
Shift+Delete deletes the next character in text controls.
Ctrl+F4 closes the active document or tab.
Alt+F4 closes the current browser window, including all tabs.

to.shell_command: /usr/bin/osascript -e 'tell application id "com.apple.finder"' -e 'if (count of Finder windows) > 0 then close front Finder window' -e 'end tell'

manipulators.description: Alt+F4 closes the front Finder window regardless of tab count.
Shift+F5 reloads without cache where supported.
Win+Space invokes the standard macOS next-input-source shortcut.
Win+M minimizes the active application windows.
Win+Left tiles the window left on macOS 15 or newer.
Win+Right tiles the window right on macOS 15 or newer.
Win+Up fills the desktop on macOS 15 or newer.
Win+Down restores the window on macOS 15 or newer.
Tap the Windows key to open Spotlight.
Tap the Windows key to open Spotlight.
Print Screen captures the full screen.
F1 remains a standard function key when media-key mode is enabled.
F2 remains a standard function key when media-key mode is enabled.
F3 remains a standard function key when media-key mode is enabled.

F9 remains a standard function key when media-key mode is enabled.
